about: The concierge's recorded model answers (plan-ex.md E1). Every message and every answer is written for the tests; no model was called. Each message has the answers each decision gives it: classify per tier of the route, amount when the message is a refund, and the reply written for each outcome. p is the raw probability of the answer; the route's maps calibrate it (maps/small.json, maps/large.json). The orders carry the Stripe charge each was paid with and the amount paid, in cents; the amount decision cites the order its message is about.

messages.text: Hi, where is my order 1002? It was due on Monday.

replies.Status: Your order is on its way. We will message you when it is delivered.

answer.text: Order 1002, your two chairs, shipped on 6 October and is due on 12 October.
